subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should remaining media-aware batching be implemented as a plugin-owned opt-in buffer for affected channels, as a generic channel SDK/gateway coalescer, or deferred to narrow channel fixes only?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes turn boundaries, latency, config shape, and channel lifecycle semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped buffer in the affected channel plugin first, reusing shared helpers only where the media contract is clear.

options.title: Design a generic coalescer
options.body: Create a broader channel SDK or gateway media coalescing contract before implementing channel-specific behavior, accepting a larger compatibility review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep current text debounce and Telegram album handling as supported behavior while handling only narrow channel bugs such as the open WhatsApp steer-media issue.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped buffer in the affected channel plugin first, reusing shared helpers only where the media contract is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, and config compatibility, which matches Peter Steinberger's history on the relevant seams.
